description: This file is a Perl module implementing a Subversion editor adapter used by 'git svn' to convert git tree differences into Subversion commit operations. It defines the package Git::SVN::Editor, with methods for generating diffs, managing directories and files, applying changes, and handling properties, serving as a core part of the 'git svn' integration.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A Perl module acting as a commit driver for 'git svn', implementing an SVN::Delta::Editor-like interface to propagate Git tree differences into Subversion operations, managing file and directory changes, properties, and transactional edits.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new Git::SVN::Editor object with options including trees to diff, repository info, and callbacks.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Generates an array of modifications by diffing two Git trees, invoking external diff-tree command, and parsing its output.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks the path types (file or directory) for all modified paths involved in the diff, caching the results for later operations.

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository path with encoding considerations applied, prepending the configured path prefix.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a given repository path, properly escaping characters if URL is HTTP/HTTPS.

methods.name: rmdirs
methods.description: Removes directories from the repository, based on accumulated deletion markers, and cleaning up working directories.

methods.name: open_or_add_dir
methods.description: Opens or adds a directory at the specified path depending on its type.

methods.name: ensure_path
methods.description: Ensures that a directory path exists in the repository, creating it if necessary, and returning the directory baton.

methods.name: glob2pat
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern string into a regular expression string.

methods.name: check_autoprop
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches an autoprop pattern and applies properties accordingly.

methods.name: apply_autoprops
methods.description: Applies auto-props based on svn config if enabled, for a given file.

methods.name: check_attr
methods.description: Checks a specific SVN attribute for a file via command line.

methods.name: apply_manualprops
methods.description: Applies manual properties from SVN attributes to a file, parsing and setting properties.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new file in the repository, applying auto and manual properties.

methods.name: C
methods.description: Handles copying (or adding a file that is a copy) in the repository, with property application.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory entry in the repository structure.

methods.name: R
methods.description: Handles renaming or replacing a file, and deleting the old one.

methods.name: M
methods.description: Modifies a file in the repository, applying text delta, property changes.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Handles toggling a file's symlink mode property.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Changes a file property, invoking the SUPER method.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Changes a directory property, invoking the SUPER method.

methods.name: _chg_file_get_blob
methods.description: Retrieves a blob associated with a file change, handling 'svn:special' and checksum calculation.

methods.name: chg_file
methods.description: Handles changing file contents using text deltas and managing blob data.

methods.name: D
methods.description: Deletes a file in the repository as part of a diff.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Closes the current set of edits, finalizing directory and file modifications.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the current edit session.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and clearing pool.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Executes the sequence of modifications generated by diffing Git trees, applying each change to the repository.
